/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('index.html')
s = p.read_text()
assert s.startswith('<"'!DOCTYPE html>'"'), 'doctype is not first'
assert s.rstrip().endswith('</html>'), 'closing html tag missing'
assert '<title>VELORA</title>' in s, 'browser title mismatch'
class Check(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.titles=[]; self.scripts=[]; self.in_title=False
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'title': self.in_title=True
        if tag == 'script': self.scripts.append(dict(attrs))
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == 'title': self.in_title=False
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.in_title: self.titles.append(data)
c=Check(); c.feed(s); c.close()
assert ''.join(c.titles) == 'VELORA', 'parsed title mismatch'
assert sum(1 for x in c.scripts if x.get('type') == 'module') == 1, 'expected one module script'
assert 'three@0.161.0' in s, 'Three.js CDN version is not pinned'
assert s.count('data-preset=') == 4, 'expected four color presets'
print('HTML structure and requested page invariants: OK')
